exact_visual_evidence: PDF page 2 is printed page 766. Its left column is the Federal Register masthead and table of contents; the contents mention Charles O. Gregory at printed page 765. The rest continues the separate naval-radio-station reservation. The full Gregory order is on PDF page 1, printed page 765.

PDF page 3, printed page 767, shows the civil-service Schedule A amendment with printed [NO. 7400] below Roosevelt's signature. EO 7398 is the Charles O. Gregory acting Secretary of Labor authorization on printed page 765.

PDF page 1, printed page 765, Gregory authorization states 'By virtue of the authority vested in me under the provisions of section 179 of the Revised Statutes of the United States (5 U. S. C., sec. 6)'; the printed number is 179, not 170.
